name: Openhook
tagline: Capture webhooks and inspect real callback payloads from your coding agent.
description: Open-source webhook inbox for testing integrations. Create a temporary inbox, send a callback to its URL, and inspect the received request through MCP. The hosted endpoint connects without an account or API key; reading and deleting an inbox require its private token as a tool argument. Capturing a callback confirms receipt, not that your application processed it. Self-hosting is also available.

install.notes: Ask the agent to create a webhook inbox, then send a test callback to the returned URL and wait for the request. Keep the inbox token private and delete the inbox when finished. Setup and callback example: https://openhook.dev/guides/callback-proof
